{{about|the TobyMac song|the Xiao Zhan song|Spotlight (Xiao Zhan song)}} {{Infobox song | name = Made to Love | cover = Madetolove tobymac.jpg | alt = | type = single | artist = [[tobyMac]] | album = Portable Sounds | released = December 26, 2006 | recorded = 2006 | studio = | venue = | genre = [[Contemporary Christian music|CCM]], [[pop rock]] | length = | label = [[ForeFront Records|ForeFront]] | writer = [[TobyMac|Toby McKeehan]], Aaron Rice, Jamie Moore, [[Cary Barlowe]] | producer = Toby McKeehan, Christopher Stevens | prev_title = Burn For You | prev_year = 2006 | next_title = Boomin' | next_year = 2007 }} "'''Made to Love"''' is a song by [[contemporary Christian music|contemporary Christian]] singer [[tobyMac]] from his third album, ''[[Portable Sounds]]''. It was released as the album's lead single on December 26, 2006. This was also included on the compilation album, ''[[WOW Hits 2008]]''. ==Music and lyrics== TobyMac wrote this song yes for the people to realize we were made to love God, but more so TobyMac telling his story. The first lines he says are very empowering, he states "''The dream is fading, now I'm staring at the door I know it's over cause my feet have hit the cold floor'' " Toby is realizing he lost that flame, that desire to live for God, that he felt too far gone (preview). One of the very last lines he states is "''I feel the haters spitting vapours on my dreams but I still believe" Toby mentions how people bring him done saying he won't make it or it is not worth walking and living for God but he believes, with God's help, he will be able to make it through.'' Throughout the song, Toby just repeats the same storyline but it is very powerful because a lot of people can relate to his story as well. "Made to Love" is generally considered a [[contemporary worship music|Christian worship]] song, both musically and lyrically.{{cite web |url=http://www.jesusfreakhideout.com/cdReviews/PortableSounds.asp |title=tobyMac, "Portable Sounds" Review |accessdate=2009-05-01 |publisher=Jesus Freak Hideout |author=John DiBiase}} It has been labeled as having a "laidback groove" with a [[neo soul]] sound.{{cite web |url={{Allmusic|class=album|id=r952812|pure_url=yes}} |title=Portable Sounds Review |accessdate=2009-04-30 |publisher=[[Allmusic]] |author=Rick Anderson}} Toby has said it was meant to be released on the ''[[Welcome to Diverse City]]'' album but he was never satisfied with the verses. The idea of the song and chorus existed for over 4–5 years prior to the actual release. He has said it was barely done in time for ''[[Portable Sounds]]'' as well. ==Release== "Made to Love" was released on December 26, 2006, in both the [[Music download|digital download]] and [[Compact Disc|CD]] formats, and includes a "musical mayhem remix" by [[Matt Bronleewe]].{{cite magazine|url={{BillboardURLbyName|artist=tobymac|chart=all}} |title=Tobymac - Made to Love |magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]] |accessdate=2009-04-30 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140709032221/http://www.billboard.com/artist/430689/tobymac/chart |archivedate=July 9, 2014 }} The song quickly began to climb on [[R&R (magazine)|''R&R'']]'s [[contemporary hit radio]] (CHR) chart at the start of 2007, and reached No. 1 during the first week of January 2007.{{cite web |url=http://www.breathecast.com/Christian.Music.Artist-tobyMac/Article-324_1432.htm |title=Tobymac Rolls Out New Project with 'Portable Sounds' Tour |date=January 31, 2007 |publisher=BREATHEcast.com |accessdate=2009-04-30}} At the end of 2007, it placed as the second top-played song on ''R&R'''s Christian CHR chart for the year, and the seventh most played song on Christian [[adult contemporary|AC]] radio. That year the song received a total of more than 23,800 plays on the Christian CHR format, and over 29,600 plays on the Christian AC format.{{cite web|url=http://www.radioandrecords.com/Formats/Charts/YearEnd/07/Christian_CHR_songs.asp |title=2007 Year End Charts: Top Christian CHR Songs |work=[[R&R (magazine)|R&R]] |accessdate=2009-04-30 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20090525095330/http://www.radioandrecords.com/Formats/Charts/YearEnd/07/Christian_CHR_songs.asp |archivedate=2009-05-25 }}{{cite web|url=http://www.radioandrecords.com/Formats/Charts/YearEnd/07/Christian_AC_songs.asp |title=2007 Year End Charts: Top Christian AC Songs |work=[[R&R (magazine)|R&R]] |accessdate=2009-04-30 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20080417193915/http://www.radioandrecords.com/Formats/Charts/YearEnd/07/Christian_AC_songs.asp |archivedate=2008-04-17 }} ===Reception=== The song was received relatively well by music critics. [[Allmusic]] reviewer Rick Anderson said that the song felt "perfectly natural — though he does sound a bit too much like a [[Sting (musician)|Sting]] imitator during the reggae interlude near the end of 'Made to Love'." Kim Jones of [[About.com]] considered it to be tobyMac's best song of his solo career,{{cite web |url=http://christianmusic.about.com/od/tobymac/tp/tobymactopsongs.htm |title=Top Songs by Gospel Rapper tobyMac - Best tobyMac Songs |publisher=[[About.com]] |author=Kim Jones |accessdate=2009-05-01 |archive-date=2009-08-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090808190411/http://christianmusic.about.com/od/tobymac/tp/tobymactopsongs.htm |url-status=dead }} and ''[[CCM Magazine]]'''s Christa Banister called it "irresistibly catchy".{{cite web |url=http://www.ccmmagazine.com/reviews/music/11538010/ |title=Portable Sounds - tobyMac - Album review |work=[[CCM Magazine]] |accessdate=2009-05-01 |author=Christa A. Banister |date=March 2007}} ===Awards=== In 2008, the song was nominated for a [[Dove Award]] for Song of the Year at the [[39th GMA Dove Awards]].[http://www.cbn.com/cbnmusic/news/021508doves.aspx Nominations Announced for 39th GMA Dove Awards] on CBN.com (February 14, 2008) The song also received a [[Grammy]] nomination in 2008 for Best Gospel Song. ==Track listing== {{track listing | headline = Album release | all_writing = Toby McKeehan, Cary Barlowe, Jamie Moore & Aaron Rice | title1 = Made to Love | length1 = 3:53 | title2 = Made to Love (Musical Mayhem Remix) | length2 = 3:20 | total_length = 7:13 }} ==Charts== {{col-begin}} {{col-2}} ===Weekly charts=== {| class="wikitable sortable plainrowheaders" style="text-align:center;" |- ! scope="col"| Chart (2007) ! scope="col"| Peak
